newsitem.title: USA: Volt Information sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Volt Information sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Volt Information Sciences Inc said Thursday its board has declared a three-for-two stock split to be distributed on May 27 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 12.
The stock split will be the distribution of one additional Volt common share for every two shares outstanding on the record date. Volt currently has 9,783,566 common shares issued and outstanding.
William Shaw, chairman and president, said the company will list its stock on the New York Stock Exchange effective May 7. The shares will trade under the ticker symbol "VOL".

Volt Information operates a technical services and temporary staffing business, provides varied services to the telecommunications industry, and furnishes electronic prepress equipment and services to the print media industry.
